title: WorkPulse job.opened v1
description: A recruitment job was opened and starts accepting candidates. Identifiers and the opening count only — title, description and all other job text stay out of the event (`.ai/security.md`).

job_id.description: The opened job (UUIDv7 string). Also the Kafka message key (ADR 0012).

position_id.description: Position the job hires for (UUIDv7 string).

department_id.description: Department the job belongs to (UUIDv7 string).

location_id.description: Location the job is based at (UUIDv7 string).

openings.description: Number of hires the job is open for; hiring stops once hired candidates reach this count.
